# Workitem 04 — Comprehensive Workspace Review

## Purpose

Run a full review of active learning content, governance, and CI after substantive changes.

## Scope

- Review active `src/weekN/` bundles.
- Verify `.cursor/skills/` and `.github/skills/` parity.
- Verify `.cursor/agents/` and `.github/agents/` parity.
- Leave preserved archive folders unchanged unless Swamy explicitly asks otherwise.

## Review Checklist

- Four-layer parity for each active week.
- Zero-copy spot check for public learning content.
- Concept-first prose in notes and notebook Markdown cells.
- README and docs match the current implementation.
- CI-aligned checks pass.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Findings are grouped as Critical, Major, and Minor.
- CI status is reported clearly.
- Any remaining migration work is described as future work, not an active failure.
